name: Sulzberg (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the arms of the market town of Sulzberg (two blue wavy bars on yellow).
history: The yellow-blue striped flag carries the arms of the market town, which were approved by the Bavarian Minister of the Interior on 25 July 1950.

features.role: Sulzberg arms — blue wavy bars on yellow
